verses.sloka: महा मात्र वचः श्रुत्वा रामः दशरथम् तदा ।अन्वभाषत वाक्यम् तु विनयज्ञो विनीतवत् ॥२-३७-१॥
verses.transliteration: mahā mātra vacaḥ śrutvā rāmaḥ daśaratham tadā ।anvabhāṣata vākyam tu vinayajño vinītavat ॥2-37-1॥

translations.english: On hearing the minister, Rama who knew how to be polite spoke these words to Dasaratha humbly:
translations.hindi: ळे ग्रयोध्याकारड का सेंतीसवाँ सर्ग समाप्त हुआ । भा )०१'--२- अष्टात्रिशः सगः ‘~’ ->>* 0° — तस्यां चौरं वसानायां नाथवत्यामनाथवत्‌ | चुक्रोश जनः सर्वो थिकत्वां दशरथं स्मिति

verses.sloka: त्यक्त भोगस्य मे राजन् वने वन्येन जीवतः ।किम् कार्यम् अनुयात्रेण त्यक्त सन्गस्य सर्वतः ॥२-३७-२॥
verses.transliteration: tyakta bhogasya me rājan vane vanyena jīvataḥ ।kim kāryam anuyātreṇa tyakta sangasya sarvataḥ ॥2-37-2॥

translations.english: O king giving up pleasures and attachments altogether I am going to live on whatever is available in the forest. What is the use of followers?
translations.hindi: इस महाकोलाहल को सुन महाराज दुःखित हुए आ जीवन में, धर्म में ओर यश में जो पहिले आ भन त्याग दिया

verses.sloka: यो हि दत्त्वा द्विप श्रेष्ठम् कक्ष्यायाम् कुरुते मनः ।रज्जु स्नेहेन किम् तस्य त्यजतः कुन्जर उत्तमम् ॥२-३७-३॥
verses.transliteration: yo hi dattvā dvipa śreṣṭham kakṣyāyām kurute manaḥ ।rajju snehena kim tasya tyajataḥ kunjara uttamam ॥2-37-3॥

translations.english: Having given away the best of elephants, will any one be interested in the rope tied to its girth? Why should one have any attachment for the rope after he has given up the elephant?
translations.hindi: +-+....... CC १ भ्रद्धां-आदरं । ( गो० ) CRONE 4 Me अल 2७००००००७००००० > ERY म सी ~ * $ I € उन्होंने उसाँस ले कर केकेयी से यह कहा--हे कैकेयी ! कुशचीर धारण कर सीता न जायगी

verses.sloka: तथा मम सताम् श्रेष्ठ किम् ध्वजिन्या जगत् पते ।सर्वाणि एव अनुजानामि चीराणि एव आनयन्तु मे ॥२-३७-४॥
verses.transliteration: tathā mama satām śreṣṭha kim dhvajinyā jagat pate ।sarvāṇi eva anujānāmi cīrāṇi eva ānayantu me ॥2-37-4॥

translations.english: O best among the virtuous O lord of the world, I do not have any use for this army. I am giving away everything (to Bharata). Bring the bark only.
translations.hindi: हमारे गुरु वसिष्ठ जी ने ठीक ही कहा है कि सीता बन जाने योग्य नहीं है | क्योंकि वह सुकुमारी बाला सदा सुख भोगने योग्य है

verses.sloka: खनित्र पिटके च उभे मम आनयत गच्चतः ।चतुर् दश वने वासम् वर्षाणि वसतः मम ॥२-३७-५॥
verses.transliteration: khanitra piṭake ca ubhe mama ānayata gaccataḥ ।catur daśa vane vāsam varṣāṇi vasataḥ mama ॥2-37-5॥

translations.english: I am going to the forest to live there for fourteen years. Bring me two things: a basket and a crowbar.
translations.hindi: क्या नृपश्रेष्ठ महाराज जनक की कन्या ने किसी का कुछ बिगाड़ा है, जो यह लोगों की भीड़ में, चीर धारण कर, मुग्धा तपस्विनी की तरह खड़ी है

verses.sloka: अथ चीराणि कैकेयी स्वयम् आहृत्य राघवम् ।उवाच परिधत्स्व इति जन ओघे निरपत्रपा ॥२-३७-६॥
verses.transliteration: atha cīrāṇi kaikeyī svayam āhṛtya rāghavam ।uvāca paridhatsva iti jana oghe nirapatrapā ॥2-37-6॥

translations.english: Thereupon in the assembly of people, without any sense of shame Kaikeyi herself brought the bark robes and said to the son of the Raghus (Rama), Wear it.
translations.hindi: मैंने यह बर नहीं दिया है कि महाराज जनक की पुत्री भी चीर धारण करे । अतः यह राजपुत्री अपेक्षित बसन-भूषण तथा समस्त उत्तम सामग्री सहित जाय

verses.sloka: स चीरे पुरुष व्याघ्रः कैकेय्याः प्रतिगृह्य ते ।सूक्ष्म वस्त्रम् अवक्षिप्य मुनि वस्त्राणि अवस्त ह ॥२-३७-७॥
verses.transliteration: sa cīre puruṣa vyāghraḥ kaikeyyāḥ pratigṛhya te ।sūkṣma vastram avakṣipya muni vastrāṇi avasta ha ॥2-37-7॥

translations.english: The tiger among men (Rama) received the bark robes from Kaikeyi and putting off the fine apparel wore the robes of an ascetic.
translations.hindi: मरने का समय निकट होने से मेरी बुद्धि बिगड़ गई । इसीसे मैंने शपथपूर्वक तुझे वर देन की प्रतिज्ञा कर के जो मूखेता का काम किया है, वह मुझे वैसे ही जला रहा है, जैसे बाँस का फूल बाँस को जलाता है

verses.sloka: लक्ष्मणः च अपि तत्र एव विहाय वसने शुभे ।तापसाच् चादने चैव जग्राह पितुर् अग्रतः ॥२-३७-८॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇaḥ ca api tatra eva vihāya vasane śubhe ।tāpasāc cādane caiva jagrāha pitur agrataḥ ॥2-37-8॥

translations.english: Lakshmana also removed his auspicious raiment in front (presence) of his father and accepted (put on) the robes of an ascetic.
translations.hindi: बाँस का फूल जब फूलता है तब वह बाँस को सुला देता है। ] रामेण यदि ते पापे किश्वित्कृतमशोभनम्‌ | अपकारः क इह ते वेदेह्या दर्शितोऽथ मे

verses.sloka: अथ आत्म परिधान अर्थम् सीता कौशेय वासिनी ।समीक्ष्य चीरम् सम्त्रस्ता पृषती वागुराम् इव ॥२-३७-९॥
verses.transliteration: atha ātma paridhāna artham sītā kauśeya vāsinī ।samīkṣya cīram samtrastā pṛṣatī vāgurām iva ॥2-37-9॥

translations.english: Then Sita in silk clothes glanced at the bark robes meant for her to wear and was frightened like a doe seeing a (fowler's) snare.

verses.sloka: सा व्यपत्रपमाणा इव प्रतिगृह्य च दुर्मनाः ।गन्धर्व राज प्रतिमम् भर्तारम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-३७-१०॥
verses.transliteration: sā vyapatrapamāṇā iva pratigṛhya ca durmanāḥ ।gandharva rāja pratimam bhartāram idam abravīt ॥2-37-10॥

translations.english: Sita of auspicious nature who knew her duties and understood righteousness, took the garments made of kusa grass from Kaikeyi. With a sense of abashment her eyes suffused with tears, she said to her husband who was the very image of the king of gandharvas.
translations.hindi: पा > १ बाल्यात--बालिशत्वा न चत्वा ( सोः० )२ एतत्‌--प्रतिज्ञातं | (गोन) 3 | , % ७ RD “7 १५२३ ०4:२९ SSE SPE त डि ५ «१ ENS / ~! अरी पापिन ! तुझे नरक में डालने के लिए श्रीरामचन्द्र का अकारण वनवास दिलाना ही पर्याप्त है, फिर न जाने अधिक दुष्ट कर्मों के करने से तेरी क्या गति होगी !

verses.sloka: अश्रुसंपूर्ण्नेत्रा च धर्मज्ञा धर्मदर्शिनी ।गन्धर्वराजप्रतिमम् भर्तारमिदमब्रवीत् ॥२-३७-११॥
verses.transliteration: aśrusaṁpūrṇnetrā ca dharmajñā dharmadarśinī ।gandharvarājapratimam bhartāramidamabravīt ॥2-37-11॥

translations.english: Sita of auspicious nature who knew her duties and understood righteousness, took the garments made of kusa grass from Kaikeyi. With a sense of abashment her eyes suffused with tears, she said to her husband who was the very image of the king of gandharvas.
translations.hindi: अभिषेक के लिये जब श्रीरामचन्द्र यहाँ आए थे, तब तूने इनसे यही न कहा था कि तुम अपना अभिषेक न करा कर ओर चीर- जटा धारण कर वन जाओ । तेरी यह बात सुन, हमने उसे (चुप- चाप--'मौनं सम्मतिलक्षणम्‌ न्याय से) स्वीकार कर लिया। ( उस समय तूने केवल श्रीरामचन्द्र ही का नाम लिया था, सीता का नहीं )

verses.sloka: कथम् नु चीरम् बध्नन्ति मुनयो वन वासिनः ।इति ह्यकुशला सीता सामुमोह मुहुर्मुहुः ॥२-३७-१२॥
verses.transliteration: katham nu cīram badhnanti munayo vana vāsinaḥ ।iti hyakuśalā sītā sāmumoha muhurmuhuḥ ॥2-37-12॥

translations.english: Sita, unacquainted with wearing bark robes, asked Rama, perplexed 'How do the sages who live in the forest wear bark garment?'.
translations.hindi: सो तू उस बात को छोड़, नरक में जाया चाहती है | तभी तो तू सीता को मुनियों जैसे चीर पहिना बन में भेजती है

verses.sloka: कृत्वा कण्ठे च सा चीरम् एकम् आदाय पाणिना ।तस्थौ हि अकुषला तत्र व्रीडिता जनक आत्मज ॥२-३७-१३॥
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā kaṇṭhe ca sā cīram ekam ādāya pāṇinā ।tasthau hi akuṣalā tatra vrīḍitā janaka ātmaja ॥2-37-13॥

translations.english: The daughter of Janaka, placed one end of the garment round her neck and held the other in her hand, and stood ashamed as she did not know what to do next.
translations.hindi: सहाराजः दशरथ विलाप कर तथा अपने शोक .का पार न देख आर अत्यन्त आतुर हो, पृथवी पर गिर पड़े ओर पुत्र के बियोगजन्य दुःखः( को स्मरण कर दुःख ) में डूब गए

verses.sloka: तस्याः तत् क्षिप्रम् आगम्य रामः धर्मभृताम् वरः ।चीरम् बबन्ध सीतायाः कौशेयस्य उपरि स्वयम् ॥२-३७-१४॥
verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ tat kṣipram āgamya rāmaḥ dharmabhṛtām varaḥ ।cīram babandha sītāyāḥ kauśeyasya upari svayam ॥2-37-14॥

translations.english: Rama, foremost among protectors of righteousness, came forward quickly and fastened the bark himself over her silk garment.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार कहते हुए और नीचा सिर किए हुए पिता महाराज ' दशरथ से, बन जाने के लिए तैयार श्रीरामचन्द्र यह वचन बोले

verses.sloka: रामम् प्रेक्ष्य तु सीतायाः बध्नन्तम् चीरमुत्तमम् ।अन्तःपुरगता नार्यो मुमुचुर्वारि नेत्रजम् ॥२-३७-१५॥
verses.transliteration: rāmam prekṣya tu sītāyāḥ badhnantam cīramuttamam ।antaḥpuragatā nāryo mumucurvāri netrajam ॥2-37-15॥

translations.english: Beholding Rama fastening the bark garment on Sita, the women of the inner apartment shed tears from their eyes.
translations.hindi: है देव ! यह मेरी माता कौसल्या जो पतिव्रता है, यशस्विनी है, बूढ़ी हे, उत्तम स्वभाव वाली है और जो कभी आपकी निन्दा नहीं करती

verses.sloka: उचुश्च परमायस्ता रामम् ज्वलिततेजसम् ।वत्स नैवम् नियुक्तेयम् वनवासे मनस्विनी ॥२-३७-१६॥
verses.transliteration: ucuśca paramāyastā rāmam jvalitatejasam ।vatsa naivam niyukteyam vanavāse manasvinī ॥2-37-16॥

translations.english: Profoundly distressed, they said to Rama glowing with burning lustre O dear, no one has ordered this highminded Sita to dwell in the forest.

verses.sloka: पितुर्वाक्यानुरोधेन गतस्य विजनम् वनम् ।तावद्दर्शनमस्या नः सफलम् भवतु प्रभो ॥२-३७-१७॥
verses.transliteration: piturvākyānurodhena gatasya vijanam vanam ।tāvaddarśanamasyā naḥ saphalam bhavatu prabho ॥2-37-17॥

translations.english: In obedience to the words of your father, O lord you are going to the forest. Till you return, please allow us to have her (Sita's) audience.
translations.hindi: आप पूज्य है, आप इसका ऐसा सम्मान या सत्कार करे हे, न : सत्कार करें, जिससे इसे पुत्र-वियोग-जन्य शोक न होने पावे और मेरे बियोग को यह _क यह सह्‌ सके तथा आपके भरोसे जीती रहे

verses.sloka: लक्ष्मणेन सहायेन वनम् गच्छस्व पुत्रक ।नेयमर्हति कल्याणी वस्तुम् तापसवद्वने ॥२-३७-१८॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇena sahāyena vanam gacchasva putraka ।neyamarhati kalyāṇī vastum tāpasavadvane ॥2-37-18॥

translations.english: Go, O son to the forest with Lakshmana as your companion. (But) this auspicious Sita, will not be able to live in the jungle like a hermit.

verses.sloka: कुरु नो याचनाम् पुत्र! सीता तिष्ठतु भामिनी ।धर्मनित्यः स्वयम् स्थातुम् न हीदानीम् त्वमिच्छसि ॥२-३७-१९॥
verses.transliteration: kuru no yācanām putra! sītā tiṣṭhatu bhāminī ।dharmanityaḥ svayam sthātum na hīdānīm tvamicchasi ॥2-37-19॥

translations.english: Do accede to our prayer. Let lovely Sita stay with us as you, O son faithful to your duty, will not like to remain here.

verses.sloka: तासामेवम्विधा वाचः शृण्वन् दशरथात्मजः ।बबन्धैव तदा चीरम् सीतया तुल्यशीलया ॥२-३७-२०॥
verses.transliteration: tāsāmevamvidhā vācaḥ śṛṇvan daśarathātmajaḥ ।babandhaiva tadā cīram sītayā tulyaśīlayā ॥2-37-20॥

translations.english: While Rama was listening to such words uttered by them, he got the bark robes fastened round Sita who was of similar nature.

verses.sloka: चीरे गृहीते तु तया समीक्ष्य नृपतेर्गुरुः ।निवार्य सीताम् कैकेयीम् वसिष्ठो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥२-३७-२१॥
verses.transliteration: cīre gṛhīte tu tayā samīkṣya nṛpaterguruḥ ।nivārya sītām kaikeyīm vasiṣṭho vākyamabravīt ॥2-37-21॥

translations.english: When Sita wore the bark garments, Vasistha, the king's preceptor who was watching this restrained her (Sita) and said to Kaikeyi:

verses.sloka: अतिप्रवृत्ते दुर्मेधे कैकेयि कुलपाम्सनि ।वञ्यित्वा च राजानम् न प्रमाणेऽवतिष्ठसे ॥२-३७-२२॥
verses.transliteration: atipravṛtte durmedhe kaikeyi kulapāmsani ।vañyitvā ca rājānam na pramāṇe'vatiṣṭhase ॥2-37-22॥

translations.english: . You are exceeding all limits of decency O Kaikeyi your motive is evil. You are a disgrace to the race You have deceived the king and your behaviour does not conform to the standards (of righteousness).

verses.sloka: न गन्तव्यम् वनम् देव्या सीतया शीलवर्जिते ।अनुष्ठास्यति रामस्य सीता प्रकृतमासनम् ॥२-३७-२३॥
verses.transliteration: na gantavyam vanam devyā sītayā śīlavarjite ।anuṣṭhāsyati rāmasya sītā prakṛtamāsanam ॥2-37-23॥

translations.english: You are devoid of good conduct, O Kaikeyi Divine Sita need not go to the forest. Remaining here she should occupy the royal throne of Rama.

verses.sloka: आत्मा हि दाराः सर्वेषाम् दारसम्ग्रहवर्तिनाम् ।आत्मेयमिति रामस्य पालयिष्यति मेदिनीम् ॥२-३७-२४॥
verses.transliteration: ātmā hi dārāḥ sarveṣām dārasamgrahavartinām ।ātmeyamiti rāmasya pālayiṣyati medinīm ॥2-37-24॥

translations.english: For every householder, his wife is the soul. Since Sita is the soul of Rama, she can rule this earth.

verses.sloka: अथ यास्यति वैदेही वनम् रामेण सम्गता ।वयमप्यनुयास्यामः पुरम् चेदम् गमिष्यति ॥२-३७-२५॥
verses.transliteration: atha yāsyati vaidehī vanam rāmeṇa samgatā ।vayamapyanuyāsyāmaḥ puram cedam gamiṣyati ॥2-37-25॥

translations.english: Otherwise, if Sita goes with Rama to the forest, all of us along with the entire city will follow.

verses.sloka: अन्तपालाश्च यास्यन्ति सदारो यत्र राघवः ।सहोपजीव्यम् राष्ट्रम् च पुरम् च सपरिच्छदम् ॥२-३७-२६॥
verses.transliteration: antapālāśca yāsyanti sadāro yatra rāghavaḥ ।sahopajīvyam rāṣṭram ca puram ca saparicchadam ॥2-37-26॥

translations.english: The guardians of the harem, its patron king Dasaratha with his retinue and, the people of this city will go wherever Rama lives with his wife.

verses.sloka: भरतश्च सशत्रुघ्नश्चीरवासा वनेचरः ।वने वसन्तम् काकुत्थ्समनुवत्स्यति पूर्वजम् ॥२-३७-२७॥
verses.transliteration: bharataśca saśatrughnaścīravāsā vanecaraḥ ।vane vasantam kākutthsamanuvatsyati pūrvajam ॥2-37-27॥

translations.english: Wandering in the forest and wearing bark, Satrughna and Bharata will live in the company of their elder brother (Rama) in the jungle.

verses.sloka: ततह् शून्याम् गतजनाम् वसुधाम् पादपैः सह ।त्वमेका शाधि दुर्वृत्ता प्रजानामहिते स्थिता ॥२-३७-२८॥
verses.transliteration: tatah śūnyām gatajanām vasudhām pādapaiḥ saha ।tvamekā śādhi durvṛttā prajānāmahite sthitā ॥2-37-28॥

translations.english: Intent upon doing harm to the people with your vile behaviour, you alone rule this kingdom full of trees and deserted by men.

verses.sloka: न हि तद्भविता राष्ट्रम् यत्र रामो न भूपतिः ।तद्वनम् भविता राष्ट्रम् यत्र रामो निवत्स्यति ॥२-३७-२९॥
verses.transliteration: na hi tadbhavitā rāṣṭram yatra rāmo na bhūpatiḥ ।tadvanam bhavitā rāṣṭram yatra rāmo nivatsyati ॥2-37-29॥

translations.english: That is not a kingdom where Rama does not rule. If Rama lives in the forest, that shall be the kingdom.

verses.sloka: न ह्यदत्ताम् महीम् पित्रा भरतः शास्तुमर्हति ।त्वयि वा पुत्रवद्वस्तुम् यदि जातो महीपतेः ॥२-३७-३०॥
verses.transliteration: na hyadattām mahīm pitrā bharataḥ śāstumarhati ।tvayi vā putravadvastum yadi jāto mahīpateḥ ॥2-37-30॥

translations.english: If Bharata is truly born to the king, he will not rule the kingdom which has not been bestowed on him (wholeheartedly) by his father. Nor will he live like a son to you.

verses.sloka: यद्यपि त्वम् क्षितितलाद्गगनम् चोत्पतिष्यसि ।पितुर्व्म्शचरित्रज्ञः सोऽन्यथा न करिष्यति ॥२-३७-३१॥
verses.transliteration: yadyapi tvam kṣititalādgaganam cotpatiṣyasi ।piturvmśacaritrajñaḥ so'nyathā na kariṣyati ॥2-37-31॥

translations.english: Even if you were to fly from earth to sky, Bharata who knows the traditions of his father's dynasty, will not act otherwise.

verses.sloka: तत्त्वया पुत्रगर्धिन्या पुत्रस्य कृतमप्रियम् ।लोके हि स न विद्येत यो न राममनुव्रतः ॥२-३७-३२॥
verses.transliteration: tattvayā putragardhinyā putrasya kṛtamapriyam ।loke hi sa na vidyeta yo na rāmamanuvrataḥ ॥2-37-32॥

translations.english: Therefore, by greedily guarding your son's interest you are doing him harm. There is none in this world who will not follow Rama.

verses.sloka: द्रक्ष्यस्यद्यैव कैकेयि पशुव्याLअमृगद्विजान् ।गच्छतः सह रामेण पादपाम्श्च तदुन्मुखान् ॥२-३७-३३॥
verses.transliteration: drakṣyasyadyaiva kaikeyi paśuvyāLamṛgadvijān ।gacchataḥ saha rāmeṇa pādapāmśca tadunmukhān ॥2-37-33॥

translations.english: Today you shall see, O Kaikeyi, flocks of cattle, elephants, deer and birds following Rama, even the trees bending towards him.

verses.sloka: अथोत्तमान्याभरणानि देवि ।देहि स्नुषायै व्यपनीय चीरम् ।न चीरमस्याः प्रविधीयतेति ।न्यवारयत् तद्वसनम् वसिष्ठः ॥२-३७-३४॥
verses.transliteration: athottamānyābharaṇāni devi ।dehi snuṣāyai vyapanīya cīram ।na cīramasyāḥ pravidhīyateti ।nyavārayat tadvasanam vasiṣṭhaḥ ॥2-37-34॥

translations.english: O Kaikeyi remove those bark robes and bestow on your daughterinlaw precious ornaments. She was not ordained to wear the bark. Vaisishta, saying so, prevented Sita from wearing that garment.

verses.sloka: एकस्य रामस्य वने निवास ।स्त्वया वृतह् केकयराजपुत्रि ।विभूषितेयम् प्रतिकर्मनित्या ।वसत्वरण्ये सह राघवेण ॥२-३७-३५॥
verses.transliteration: ekasya rāmasya vane nivāsa ।stvayā vṛtah kekayarājaputri ।vibhūṣiteyam pratikarmanityā ।vasatvaraṇye saha rāghaveṇa ॥2-37-35॥

translations.english: O Kaikeyi, you asked that Rama only should dwell in the forest (wearing bark robes). Therefore let Sita, adorn her body daily, while she lives in the forest with Rama.

verses.sloka: यानैश्च मुख्यैः परिचारकैश्च ।सुसम्वृता गच्छतु राजपुत्री ।वस्रैश्च सर्वैः सहितैर्विधानै ।र्नेयम् वृता ते वरसम्प्रदाने ॥२-३७-३६॥
verses.transliteration: yānaiśca mukhyaiḥ paricārakaiśca ।susamvṛtā gacchatu rājaputrī ।vasraiśca sarvaiḥ sahitairvidhānai ।rneyam vṛtā te varasampradāne ॥2-37-36॥

translations.english: Equipped with excellent chariots, attendants, garments, and all other needs let the princess (Sita) go. While seeking boons, you did not include Sita.

verses.sloka: तस्मिम्स्तथा जल्पति विप्रमुख्ये ।गुरौ नृपस्याप्रतिमप्रभावे ।नैव स्म सीता विनिवृत्तभावा ।प्रियस्य भर्तुः प्रतिकारकामा ॥२-३७-३७॥
verses.transliteration: tasmimstathā jalpati vipramukhye ।gurau nṛpasyāpratimaprabhāve ।naiva sma sītā vinivṛttabhāvā ।priyasya bhartuḥ pratikārakāmā ॥2-37-37॥

translations.english: (Though) Vasistha, endowed with matchless power, the preceptor of the king and foremost among the brahmins thus expressed himself, Sita was not willing to swerve from her resolve in order to serve her beloved husband. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे सप्तत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyseventh sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
